captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic bicycle dropper seatpost assembly. It features a dark teal seat-tube stub at the bottom, topped by a black clamp collar with a visible tightening bolt. Rising from the collar is a telescoping black post body with subtle silver height markings, supporting a saddle clamp assembly with metallic rails. At the very top is a contoured black bicycle saddle shell. The telescoping post moves relative to the seat-tube stub via a prismatic joint, allowing height adjustment.
captions.instruction: Create a detailed 3D model of a bicycle dropper seatpost assembly with a seat-tube stub, telescoping post, collar clamp, and a realistic saddle with rails. Implement a prismatic joint to allow the seat height to telescope along the vertical axis, using dark teal, matte black, and metallic materials.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using multiple parts and a prismatic joint. The base is built from a cylinder representing the seat-tube stub, joined to a collar clamp made by combining a cylinder with a small box and a cylindrical bolt cutout. The telescoping inner post is constructed from a narrower cylinder with decorative silver rings. The saddle is modeled by sweeping a custom profile or using a lofted shape, supported by metallic rails made from bent cylinders, and is attached to the post via a multi-piece clamp bracket.
